title: Priya and the Lost Red Boot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=32 beats='First snowy day at Maple Hill; Priya and her little brother Arjun finish one last sled ride; Arjun wiggles his toes and one small red boot is gone'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=36 beats='Mama expects them home for the walk before dark; Priya promises Arjun she will find the boot; the churned sled run stretches below while the sled shed and the big kids wait off to the side'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=32 beats='Priya and Arjun tromp along the top of the run; the snow is churned into lumps; Arjun hops on one boot and squeezes the mitten of Priya'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=36 beats='Two clues at once; a deep snow pile by their green sled makes a soft thump when Priya pats it, and long drag marks wiggle away down the slope toward the big bump'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=32 beats='The snow pile is taller than Arjun; Priya turns the green sled into a giant scoop; snow flies in sparkly clouds until a deep hole opens'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=36 beats='The hole is a little blue-white snow cave; at the bottom Priya spots a stiff red lace and a soggy wet mitten; Arjun holds her scarf like a rope while she stretches down'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=32 beats='The drag marks wiggle downhill beside small boot prints and one sock print; Priya follows them like a detective to the big bump where the run gets fast'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=36 beats='A drift curls beside the big bump like a frozen wave; something small and round bumps up under the smooth snow skin; Priya can brush gently or stomp it flat to see faster'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='Priya thinks good hunters ask for help; the old sled shed glows with lantern light where Mr. Okafor the hill caretaker knows every corner of Maple Hill; by the rope tow the big kids Sam and Lena saw Arjun spin past this morning; Arjun tugs both ways at once and Priya must choose'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='The sled shed smells like wood and wet wool and loaner sleds lean in rows; Mr. Okafor tips his warm hat and listens to the whole boot story; he says small red things love to hide in white snow; they can search the shadowy shed together or borrow his bright lantern and comb the run before dark'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=32 beats='In the back corner sit the loaner sleds carried in after the morning rides plus the found things box; Arjun tries a blue boot from the box and it flops like a clown shoe'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=36 beats='A flipped red sled hides a pocket of shadows and the box has a deep unsorted bottom; outside the window the sky turns purple; Mr. Okafor offers his big hill map for a morning plan'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=32 beats='The lantern makes the snow glow gold as Priya carries it down the run; every red thing on the hill glints like a jewel, scarves and flags and something low'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=36 beats='One low shape glints near the bottom of the run and another wink of red flashes from the dark pine trees; the sky is nearly night and there is time to check only one'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=32 beats='Sam and Lena listen to the boot story and clap their mittens; Sam remembers Arjun laughing as his sled spun around this morning; they want to help right now'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=36 beats='Lena says a line of hunters sees everything so the four of them spread out arm to arm across the run; Arjun rides the shoulders of Priya calling directions like a captain'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=32 beats='The line of hunters brushes every lump in the fast lane; snow flies like confetti; near the bottom Lena shouts that she might see something small and red just as the first hill lamp flickers'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=32 beats='The hill lamps hum on one by one and the snow turns lamp-post gold; the hunt must stop for tonight; Arjun yawns a huge yawn from the shoulders of Priya'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Priya pulls the frozen lace and the little red boot pops free with a shower of snow; Arjun cheers and stuffs his cold toes inside; they stomp matching boot prints all the way home; Mama has hot cocoa waiting and Priya feels ten feet tall'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Under the soggy mitten waits a whole snow nest of lost treasures, a whistle, a pom-pom, and the little red boot of Arjun tucked in the middle; Priya carries the extra treasures to the shed like a hero; Arjun wears his boot and a giant grin on the walk home to Mama'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='One gentle brush and the little red boot rises out of the drift like a treasure from the sea; Priya holds it up like a trophy while Arjun dances on one foot; warm boot, warm toes, warm hearts; they reach Mama at the gate just as the first stars blink on'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='The stomp packs the snow down hard and the round shape sinks deeper out of reach; the hill lamps hum on which means time is up for today; Priya wraps the cold foot of Arjun in her spare scarf like a puffy sock; the one boot walk home is slow and a little sad, but tomorrow the hill will still be there'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='There under the flipped red sled sits the little red boot, dry and safe, carried in with the loaners after the morning rides; Mr. Okafor laughs his big warm laugh; Arjun hugs the boot like a puppy before putting it on; they thank the caretaker twice and march home to tell Mama the story'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='No boot tonight, but Mr. Okafor marks every searched spot on his big hill map and promises a morning sweep; Priya copies the map in the snow outside so she remembers it too; Arjun rides home on her back planning tomorrow like a general; the hunt is paused, not over'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='The lantern light lands on the low shape and there it is, the little red boot half buried where the sleds stop; Arjun squeals so loudly an owl hoots back; boot on, toes warm, lantern returned with two thank yous; Priya and Arjun glow all the way home to Mama'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='The wink of red in the pines is only a forgotten flag ribbon; the lantern oil runs low and the snow keeps its secret for tonight; Priya promises Arjun the hunt starts again after breakfast; he rides her shoulders through the gate where Mama waits with warm socks'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=36 beats='It is the little red boot, dusted with sparkles; everyone cheers so loudly the pine trees drop snow; Arjun wears his boot and waves like a champion all the way home to Mama'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=36 beats='Priya turns the walk home into a piggyback parade with Sam and Lena marching behind; Mama meets them with dry socks and cocoa; the hill keeps one small secret until tomorrow'>>
